# Aureus ERP: Aureus ERP \- An open source ERP platform developed with Laravel, designed to meet the needs of both Small and Medium Enterprises \(SMEs\) and large\-scale businesses\.

> Aureus ERP is a top open\-source ERP platform for growing businesses\. It helps you manage sales, CRM, inventory, accounting, HR, and more\.
